To: @renee.whitlock
Replying to: s01
Cc: none
Subject: Football rundown for Monday admin meeting

Renee, here’s our rundown for the noon meeting. Been a good week for these kids, and they’ve got plenty to be proud of.

We beat Brookhollow 31-14 Friday and finished second in the region. Deshawn Pettaway had 3 sacks and 7 tackles. The kids voted him defensive player of the week right there in the locker room before the coaches even met. That tells you what his teammates thought of his night. Defense held Brookhollow to 46 yards rushing in the second half.

Tavion Hurst finished with 188 yards rushing and 2 touchdowns. His long touchdown in the third quarter was a big one, but I want to give that offensive line their due. They were pushing folks 5 yards back that whole drive. Best I’ve seen them block all year.

We have a HOME playoff game this Friday, November 13, against Clanton Valley. Kickoff is 7 p.m. at Ridge Field, and presale tickets start Tuesday. Please make sure Dr. Pruitt knows we’re home and help us get the word out. Would love to have folks come out for these boys. Gate and chain crews need confirming by Wednesday, and boosters still need 6 more concession volunteers. Their signup sheet goes out today.

Academically, all 52 players are eligible after the nine-week grade check. Tonya Greer deserves the credit for that, not me. Her Tuesday and Thursday study hall is making a difference, and she’s keeping it going through the playoffs.

Boosters sold 208 Boston butts and raised $6,240 against a $4,500 goal. That money is going toward new sideline headsets. Carla and the booster crew did a great job, and Hargrove’s Meat Market deserves a thank-you for smoking them at cost.

If we win and go on the road, I’ll get the bus information to you with that five-day transportation deadline in mind.
